releaseNotes: v1.38.0 — Listen to the Bible in English, spoken aloud. English Bible audio now uses the public-domain World English Bible (WEB) recording from eBible.org, matching the app's own English text verse for verse — so the audio reads exactly what you see. Amharic chapters keep the WordProject recording. Requires a connection to download the chapter audio once, then it's cached for offline listening. Also fixes a stale-player bug where tapping play after switching chapters could act on the previous chapter instead of the one you're reading.
